message.content: PCBMTL model tackles low-data problem. Learned segmentation knowledge improves feature representation learning for PCB images. Segmentation task requires extra labels of soldering point positions. PCBMTL with focal loss addresses imbalanced dataset problem by becoming more focused on hard samples. PCBMTL plus focal loss consistently surpasses existing approaches e.g. ResNet50, VGG16
